summary: PASS. Search-first ONBOARDING doorway + new GET /api/search verified end-to-end. action_items: None required for this iteration — onboarding rebuild passes all acceptance criteria (backend search endpoint, search-first UI, follow chip rail, honest empty state, no mic/permissions calls, Enter My Ticker lands on Home with followed picks reflected).

critical_code_review_comments: backend/providers/nhl.py search() aggregates verified NHL teams (via standings cache w/ 1h TTL) + real player search (https://search.d3.nhle.com/api/v1/search/player) — no fabricated results paths; unknown providers simply omit rows.
backend/providers/registry.py search_all() iterates every provider whose capabilities.search=True; adding a future league (e.g. CHL) automatically extends onboarding coverage.
server.py /api/search wraps search_all in try/except and always returns {query, results:[]} on failure — matches the 'honest empty state' contract.
frontend/app/onboarding.tsx uses debounced (250ms) universal search with a run-id race guard (runId.current) so late responses cannot overwrite newer results.

frontend follow state is client-local until completeOnboarding() persists via storage; shape matches follows.tsx type (teams[abbr,name], players[player_id,team_abbr,name,pos]). Tier was intentionally removed and follows.tsx still exposes it as optional — non-breaking.
frontend/src/lib/api.ts search() uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded host.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding is now search-first (Phase 1 welcome + Phase 2 build). Reset via /onboarding?reset=1. Keys: testID welcome-go -> onboard-search -> result-team-{ABBR} / result-player-{PID} -> onboard-finish. Follow chip rail rows are Pressable Views labelled by team ABBR or player last name; to click a chip use JS evaluate to find the element whose textContent equals the label. Provider search returns team.id = team_abbr (e.g. 'MTL'), player.id = playerId (e.g. '8484144'). Non-NHL queries (WHL, Kamloops, Swiss) MUST return [] — do not treat that as a bug. Instrumentation pattern (unchanged from iter_7): page.context.add_init_script BEFORE page.goto to count fetch URLs + permission/getUserMedia. New probe key: window.__probe.searchCalls captures every /api/search hit. Backend NHL player search hits an external NHL service (search.d3.nhle.com) — allow up to ~2.5s per query in Playwright.
